sloka: अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा इन्द्रजित्समितिञ्जयः ।अमरत्वमहं देव वृणे यद्येष मुच्यते ।। ७.३०.८ ॥
transliteration: athābravīnmahātejā indrajitsamitiñjayaḥ ।amaratvamahaṁ deva vṛṇe yadyeṣa mucyate ।। 7.30.8 ॥

translations.english: Then, the greatly effulgent Indrajit, the conqueror in battle, spoke, saying, "O god, I choose immortality if this one (Indra) is released."
